openwrt_wiki.Recovery through u-boot: Reset-Knopf beim Einschalten halten; U-Boot zeigt: 'Keep button pressed for at least: 3s for web based recovery, 5s for U-Boot console, 7s for network console'; nach 3 s: 'HTTP server is starting at IP: 192.168.1.1', Ethernet 1/100 Mbps
openwrt_wiki.Serial: On the PCB, there is a 4 pad with solder on them on the top-upper-right of the PCB. At least TX is available on it. We have: [GND] [TX] [RX] [VCC?]. To get RX working I had to connect to the other side of R11.
openwrt_wiki.Hardware mods / USB device: It's possible to add support for USB device by connecting D+ and D- to the USB connector wires as seen on a picture in the pull request (PR 2199)
openwrt_wiki.Pinouts: There is a connector on the middle of the bottom of the top pcb: [VCC?][D+][D-][GND][?][VCC?]. For the serial connector: [GND] [TX] [RX] [VCC?]. TX<->R12<->?; "RX"<->R11<->SOC_RX

openwrt_git_ar71xx.Beschreibung: ALFA Network AP121F is a pocket-size router dedicated for VPN/TOR users. Device is based on Atheros AR9331 WiSoC and is running a custom version (updated from OpenWrt CC to LEDE 17.01 release) of NetAidKit firmware.
openwrt_git_ar71xx.Flash instruction: under U-Boot web recovery mode: PC 192.168.1.2/24, RJ45 verbinden, Reset druecken, Strom an, nach erstem Blinken aller LEDs Knopf weitere 3 Blinkzyklen halten, 192.168.1.1 im Browser, sysupgrade-Image hochladen
